arxiv-2202-03765.title: Towards modified bimetric theories within non-product spectral geometry
arxiv-2202-03765.creator: Arkadiusz Bochniak
arxiv-2202-03765.description: Abstract We discuss class of doubled geometry models with diagonal metrics. Based on the analysis of known examples we formulate a hypothesis that supports treating them as modified bimetric gravity theories. Certain steps towards the generic case are then performed.

arxiv-2304-03551.title: Femtosecond laser induced creation of G and W-centers in silicon-on-insulator substrates
arxiv-2304-03551.creator: Hugo Quard 1, Mario Khoury 2, Andong Wang 3, Tobias Herzig 4, Jan Meijer 4, Sebastian Pezzagna 4, Sébastien Cueff 1, David Grojo 3, Marco Abbarchi 2,5, Hai Son Nguyen 1,6, Nicolas Chauvin 1, Thomas Wood 1
arxiv-2304-03551.description: Abstract The creation of fluorescent defects in silicon is a key stepping stone towards assuring the integration perspectives of quantum photonic devices into existing technologies. Here we demonstrate the creation, by femtosecond laser annealing, of W and G-centers in commercial silicon on insulator (SOI) previously implanted with 12 C + ions.

arxiv-2306-01667.title: Towards In-context Scene Understanding
arxiv-2306-01667.creator: Ivana Balažević David Steiner Nikhil Parthasarathy Relja Arandjelović Olivier J. HénaffGoogle DeepMind
arxiv-2306-01667.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ivana Balažević David Steiner Nikhil Parthasarathy Relja Arandjelović Olivier J. HénaffGoogle DeepMind. In-context learning—the ability to configure a model’s behavior with different prompts—has revolutionized the field of natural language processing, alleviating the need for task-specific models and paving the way for generalist models capable of assisting with any query. Computer vision, in contrast, has largely stayed in the former regime: specialized decoders and finetuning protocols are generally required to perform dense tasks such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation.

arxiv-2312-02153.title: Aligning and Prompting Everything All at Once for Universal Visual Perception
arxiv-2312-02153.creator: Yunhang Shen, Chaoyou Fu, Peixian Chen, Mengdan Zhang
arxiv-2312-02153.description: Abstract Vision foundation models have been explored recently to build general-purpose vision systems. However, predominant paradigms, driven by casting instance-level tasks as an object-word alignment, bring heavy cross-modality interaction, which is not effective in prompting object detection and visual grounding.

arxiv-2503-06360.title: Analytical and numerical solutions to the three-phase Stefan problem with simultaneous occurrences of melting, solidification, boiling, and condensation phenomena
arxiv-2503-06360.creator: Mehran Soleimani, Kimmo Koponen, Nils Tilton, Amneet Pal Singh Bhalla
arxiv-2503-06360.description: Abstract The one-dimensional (1D) Stefan problem is a prototypical heat and mass transfer problem that analyzes the temperature distribution in a material undergoing phase change. In addition, it describes the evolution of the phase change front within the phase change material (PCM).

arxiv-2506-13785.title: LLM-Driven Data Generation and a Novel Soft Metric for Evaluating Text-to-SQL in Aviation MRO Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2506-13785.creator: Patrick Sutanto, Jonathan Kenrick, Max Lorenz, Joan Santoso
arxiv-2506-13785.description: Abstract The application of Large Language Models (LLMs) to text-to-SQL tasks promises to democratize data access, particularly in critical industries like aviation Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO). However, progress is hindered by two key challenges: the rigidity of conventional evaluation metrics such as execution accuracy, which offer coarse, binary feedback, and the scarcity of domain-specific evaluation datasets.

pmc-10529663.title: Unmet Needs in the Assessment of Right Ventricular Function for Severe Tricuspid Regurgitation
pmc-10529663.creator: Vasileios Anastasiou, Maria-Anna Bazmpani, Stylianos Daios, Dimitrios V Moysidis, Thomas Zegkos, Matthaios Didagelos, Theodoros Karamitsos, Konstantinos Toutouzas, Antonios Ziakas, Vasileios Kamperidis, Riemer HJA Slart
pmc-10529663.description: Tricuspid regurgitation (TR) is a highly prevalent valvular heart disease that has been long overlooked, but lately its independent association with adverse cardiovascular outcomes was recognized. The time point to intervene and repair the tricuspid valve is defined by the right ventricular (RV) dilation and dysfunction that comes up at a later stage.

pmc-10667053.title: A Preliminary Study on the Relationship between Arthropod Diversity and Vegetation Diversity in Four Contrasting Ecosystems in Hanthana Mountain Range of Sri Lanka, during the Post-Monsoon Dry Season
pmc-10667053.creator: W. A. Manasee Weerathunga, A. M. Gihan Athapaththu, L. D. Amarasinghe
pmc-10667053.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This study assesses the relationship between arthropod and vegetation diversity in four ecosystems with different types of vegetation, during a post-monsoonal season. We determined the arthropod diversity in vegetation surrounding an aquatic environment (AQ), a broad-leaved wet, evergreen forest ecosystem (BL), a Pinus caribaea monoculture plantation (PN), and a Pinus plantation artificially enriched with indigenous broad-leaved tree species (PNEN) located in the Hanthana mountain range, Sri Lanka.

pmc-11346331.creator: Manar Alzahrani, Sondus Bakhreibah, Nada Alharbi, Lama Alamoudi, Seba Halloul, Sara Alamoudi, Raghad Alharthi, Salem Baghdadi, Ahmed Alamoudi
pmc-11346331.description: The present systematic review and meta-analysis has systematically reviewed and analyzed dental implant failure for the implants placed in the esthetic zone. An electronic database search was performed in PubMed and ScienceDirect, including a manual search through the references using appropriate keywords and the PICO (population, intervention, control, and outcomes) format for the inclusion criteria.

pmc-11975520.title: IL-37抑制恶性黑色素瘤转移的体内研究
pmc-11975520.creator: 建堂 杨, 丽丽 付, 焱淼 杨, 琳 林
pmc-11975520.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). 目的恶性黑色素瘤恶性程度极高，早期即可发生转移，预后极差，严重威胁着人类的健康，研究抑制其转移相关的分子及机制对其治疗及预后有重要意义。白细胞介素(interleukin，IL)-37作为抗炎细胞因子，不仅与多种炎症性疾病有关，还具有抗肿瘤作用。本研究旨在通过建立恶性黑色素瘤肺转移小鼠模型，研究IL-37对小鼠体内恶性黑色素瘤转移的作用。方法将IL-37过表达(IL-37 overexpression，IL-37 oe)和Vector质粒分别转染小鼠黑色素瘤细胞B16F1，设置IL-37 oe组(加入转染试剂及IL-37 oe质粒)、空白对照(Blank)组(只加入转染试剂)和Vector组(加入转染试剂及Vector质粒)。C57小鼠随机分为3组，每组3只。分别收集处于对数生长期的Blank组、Vector组和IL-37 oe组B16F1细胞在无菌条件下进行小鼠尾静脉注射。每3天称量并记录小鼠体重。1个月后，采用颈椎脱臼法处死小鼠，分别解剖并分离各组小鼠肺器官及心、肝、脾、肾等脏器，肺器官采图并记录转移结节数；小鼠心、肝、脾、肾等各脏器组织用4%的多聚甲醛固定后制作石蜡切片，并进行苏木精-伊红(hematoxylin and eosin，HE)染色。结果蛋白质印迹显示质粒构建成功。第1、4、7、10、13、16、19、22、25和28天，IL-37 oe组小鼠体重较Blank组和Vector组差异均无统计学意义(均P>0.05)。解剖小鼠肺器官发现肺部肿瘤结节，表明建模成功。HE染色发现 IL-37 oe组小鼠心、肝、脾、肾等脏器组织形态学变化较Blank组和Vector组均无明显差异。3组小鼠的肺组织中，Blank组肺转移的结节数为(24.00±2.08)个，Vector组肺转移的结节数为(24.67±0.88)个，IL-37 oe组为(5.33±1.45)个；IL-37 oe组肺部的转移结节数目明显低于Blank组和Vector组(均P<0.05)，而Blank组和Vector组间差异无统计学意义(P>0.05)。结论IL-37在小鼠体内能抑制恶性黑色素瘤细胞肺转移结节数，且对小鼠体重及其他脏器无明显影响，有望成为恶性黑色素瘤基因治疗或免疫治疗的潜在分子靶标。 恶性黑色素瘤来源于黑色素细胞，多发生于皮肤，也可发生于黏膜和内脏，其生长迅速，侵袭性强，恶性程度极高。虽然黑色素瘤的发病率不高，但是患者入院治疗时多已出现转移，预后差、致死率高[1]。 白细胞介素(interleukin，IL)-37是IL-1家族的细胞因子，具有抑制炎症反应的作用[2-3]，成熟的IL-37可以通过细胞外途径与IL-18结合蛋白(IL-18 binding protein，IL-18BP)结合[4]，也可以通过细胞内途径与Sma和Mad相关蛋白3(Sma- and Mad-related protein，Smad)结合，从而参与固有免疫应答。现有研究[5-8]证实，IL-37与众多疾病的发生、发展密切相关[3]，如炎症性皮肤病、消化系统疾病、自身免疫性疾病、代谢性疾病、缺血再灌注(ischemia/reperfusion，I/R)损伤等。同时，IL-37在结肠癌、非小细胞肺癌、宫颈癌、肝癌等肿瘤中表现出抗肿瘤活性[9-14]。在前期研究[15]中，课题组也证实IL-37在口腔白斑、口腔鳞状细胞癌的发病过程中具有一定的抑制作用。 目前尚无关于IL-37在恶性黑色素瘤中作用的研究，其抗肿瘤作用的体内研究也较少。研究影响恶性黑色素瘤转移的因素，积极探索其潜在的治疗靶点，对于提高患者生存率及改善生存质量具有重要意义。本研究旨在采用黑色素瘤细胞构建动物肺转移模型，探究IL-37对小鼠恶性黑色素瘤细胞转移的影响，以期为后续研究IL-37在恶性黑色素瘤或其他恶性肿瘤中的作用及机制提供基础，并为其未来作为恶性肿瘤治疗靶点的探索提供依据。 材料与方法 材料 动物与细胞 6~8周龄雌性C57小鼠购自成都达硕实验动物有限公司。动物置于恒温(25~27 ℃)、恒湿(45%~50%)、新鲜空气、高度除菌的环境下饲养，垫料、食物及水均经过标准灭菌处理。本研究已获得遵义医科大学附属口腔医院伦理委员会批准(审批号：伦审〔2021〕2-431)。小鼠黑色素瘤细胞B16F1购自美国菌种保藏中心(American Type Culture Collection，ATCC)细胞库。 试剂 IL-37过表达(IL-37 overexpression，IL-37 oe)质粒及阴性对照(Vector)质粒由北京傲锐东源生物科技有限公司构建，质粒浓度为1 µg/(5×104)细胞。杜氏改良Eagle培养基(Dulbecco’s modified Eagle medium，DMEM)培养基购自美国GIBICO公司，胎牛血清购自成都哈里生物工程有限公司，双叉丙烯酰胺购自瑞士Fluka公司，聚偏氟乙烯(polyvinylidene difluoride，PVDF)膜购自美国Millipore公司，甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶(glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase，GAPDH)抗体购自美国Cell Signaling Techology公司，IL-37抗体购自美国Proteintech公司。 方法 过表达质粒的转染 转染前1 d取对数生长期B16F1细胞，制成细胞悬液，细胞以3×105个/孔的密度接种于6孔板中。24 h后，待细胞汇合度约50%后开始转染。按照Lipofectamine 2000转染说明书步骤进行转染。设置IL-37 oe组(加入转染试剂及IL-37 oe质粒)，空白对照(Blank)组(只加入转染试剂)和Vector组(加入转染试剂及Vector质粒)。 建立小鼠肺转移癌模型 C57小鼠随机分为3组，每组3只。分别收集处于对数生长期的Blank组、Vector组和IL-37 oe组B16F1细胞，1×磷酸盐缓冲溶液(phosphate buffered saline，PBS)洗涤2次，1 500 r/min离心3 min，细胞沉淀用新鲜无血清、无抗生素的DMEM培养基重悬，计数，调整细胞浓度为2×105/50 µL，在无菌条件下进行小鼠尾静脉注射，每3天称量小鼠体重，并观察小鼠的精神状态、饮食情况、毛发光滑亮泽程度及生存情况。 模型小鼠的解剖 建模1个月后，采用颈椎脱臼法处死小鼠，解剖并分离小鼠肺器官及其他脏器，肺器官采图并记录转移结节个数。 固定及包埋 小鼠各脏器组织采用4%的多聚甲醛液固定后制作石蜡切片，并进行苏木精-伊红(hematoxylin and eosin，HE)染色。 统计学处理 采用IBM SPSS Statistics 29软件进行数据分析，符合正态分布的计量资料以均数±标准差表示，采用t检验分析。以α=0.05为检验水准，P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。采用Orign软件进行数据作图。 结 果 成功构建IL-37 oe质粒 通过蛋白质印迹检测，在50 kD(1 D=1 u)位置观察到清晰的目标蛋白质条带，与Vector组比较， IL-37蛋白质条带仅在IL-37 oe组中检测到，且条带强度均显著高于Blank组和Vector组，表明质粒构建成功并实现了目标蛋白质的表达(图1)。 蛋白质印迹检测构建的IL-37 oe质粒 Figure

pmc-12423866.title: Selectively Adsorbed CO and O2 on Transition-Metal-Incorporated Porphyrin
pmc-12423866.creator: Janghwan Cha, Hoonkyung Lee, Suklyun Hong
pmc-12423866.description: We have investigated the adsorption of CO and O2 on transition-metal (TM)-incorporated porphyrin. Our calculations show that one or more CO molecules can be adsorbed on the Sc-, Ti-, V-, Cr-, or Mn-incorporated porphyrin, while only one CO molecule is adsorbed on the Fe- or Co-incorporated porphyrin.

pmc-12463930.title: A cavernous hemangioma in the small intestine of a teenage boy: a case report and literature review
pmc-12463930.creator: Tian Xie, Yi Long
pmc-12463930.description: BackgroundA cavernous hemangioma in the small intestine is rare. Due to its hidden location and non-specific clinical symptoms, it is difficult to diagnose accurately. Here, we describe a 14-year-old boy with a cavernous hemangioma and bleeding at the junction of the jejunum and ileum.Case summaryThe patient presented with clinical manifestations including melena, dizziness, fatigue, pale complexion, and shock.

pmc-12602623.title: A practice-oriented guide to statistical inference in linear modeling for non-normal or heteroskedastic error distributions
pmc-12602623.creator: Hanna Rajh-Weber, Stefan Ernest Huber, Martin Arendasy
pmc-12602623.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Selecting an appropriate statistical method is a challenge frequently encountered by applied researchers, especially if assumptions for classical, parametric approaches are violated. To provide some guidelines and support, we compared classical hypothesis tests with their typical distributional assumptions of normality and homoskedasticity with common and easily accessible alternative inference methods (HC3, HC4, and six bootstrap methods) in the framework of ordinary least squares (OLS) regression.

pmc-12691465.title: MerTK and the Role of Phagoptosis in Neonatal Hypoxia-Ischemia
pmc-12691465.creator: Andrea Jonsdotter, Henrik Hagberg, Anna-Lena Leverin, Joakim Ek, Kerstin Ebefors, Eridan Rocha-Ferreira, Ylva Carlsson
pmc-12691465.description: Highlights What are the main findings? MerTK and other key phagoptosis-related molecules are upregulated in the neonatal brain after hypoxia-ischemia.Deletion of MerTK reduces microglial engulfment of neurons and significantly attenuates gray and white matter injury. What are the implications of the main findings? Our findings indicate a potential contribution of phagoptosis to neuronal loss following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia.

pmc-12921409.title: Helping or watching it happen: how participants respond to robot failures in a turn-taking game
pmc-12921409.creator: Samantha Stedtler, Katherine Harrison, Valentina Fantasia
pmc-12921409.description: Robot failures in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), though often stemming from technical limitations, can have severe effects on the interactional dynamics between humans and robots. Prior empirical research has led to conflicting findings on how such failures influence user perceptions and the overall success of the interaction.

pmc-13019888.title: Memory and learning impairments in deficit and non-deficit schizophrenia: a scoping review
pmc-13019888.creator: Piotr Plichta, Monika Mak, Jerzy Samochowiec, Ernest M. Tyburski
pmc-13019888.description: PurposeThe evidence available indicates that patients with deficit schizophrenia experience more pronounced global cognitive impairments than non-deficit patients. Whether this syndrome is also marked by disproportionately greater difficulties in memory and learning remains unclear. This scoping review aimed to map the existing literature on differences in memory and learning between deficit and non-deficit schizophrenia patients, relative to healthy controls.

pmc-13029036.title: Mineral–Vitamin Complexes in Sheep Nutrition: Patent Analysis and Functional Evaluation for Pregnant Ewes and Lambs
pmc-13029036.creator: Saltanat Baibatyrova, Akniyet Onerbayeva, Amirbek Sagyzbaev, Temirkhan Kenzhebaev, Zhazira Mukatayeva, Indira Kurmanbayeva
pmc-13029036.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Natural pasture, the primary feed source in sheep production, often provides insufficient levels of essential minerals and vitamins required for proper metabolic regulation during pregnancy and early development. This study aimed to analyze patent developments of mineral and vitamin complexes (MVCs) for pregnant ewes and lambs and to evaluate the biochemical and molecular relevance of their components based on scientific evidence.

pmc-13226956.title: The Enactive Torch: Open-source sensory substitution device for neurophysiological research
pmc-13226956.creator: Stephen Estelle, Lohith Dayantri, Ziwen Meng, Brian Morrissey, Tom Froese
pmc-13226956.description: We present the updated Enactive Torch (ET), an open-source, multimodal sensory substitution device engineered to facilitate synchronized haptic stimulation and neurophysiological data acquisition, particularly electroencephalography (EEG). Designed for modularity and accessibility, the ET converts distance measurements from a LiDAR sensor into vibratory feedback via internal and external actuators, enabling embodied perception studies across diverse research contexts.

pmc-13287368.title: Cold agglutinin syndrome secondary to Epstein–Barr virus reactivation during corticosteroid therapy for minimal change nephrotic syndrome in a patient with human immunodeficiency virus infection
pmc-13287368.creator: Harui Bamba, Daisuke Katagiri, Keiki Shimada, Hitomi Otani, Naoto Eriguchi, Yuri Katayama, Mikako Koizumi, Minami Suzuki, Hideki Takano

pmc-13566346.title: Artesunate in Ferroptosis and Cuproptosis Regulation: Context-Dependent Mechanisms, Interplay, and Therapeutic Implications
pmc-13566346.creator: Kai Feng, Yayi Xia, Jingsheng Liu, Mingxuan Yang
pmc-13566346.description: The discovery of ferroptosis and cuproptosis has significantly expanded the landscape of programmed cell death. Artesunate (ART), a semisynthetic derivative of artemisinin, exhibits pleiotropic pharmacological activities beyond its canonical antimalarial role, including anticancer and neuroprotective effects. However, a comprehensive review systematically integrating ART’s roles in modulating both ferroptosis and cuproptosis remains lacking.

pmc-13680497.title: Matrix metalloproteinase-guided targeting of vesicular stomatitis virus to tumors following systemic administration
pmc-13680497.creator: Eileen Victoria Theune, William C. Theune, Elham Ahmadi, Conner C. Chiari, Neha Singh, Rory Geyer, Jason Tonne, Muriel Metko, Olamide T. Olaoba, Isabella China Wang, Dylan Dai, Jianbin Ruan, Robert Clark, Guangfu Li, Penghua Wang, Evan R. Jellison, Anthony T. Vella, Richard Vile, Kepeng Wang
pmc-13680497.description: The lack of tumor-specific targeting by oncolytic viruses (OVs) restricts their therapeutic potential. Here, we report a “cap-linker” strategy to modify the vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV) glycoprotein (G protein, VSV-GIN). The modified VSV (Pro-VSVIN) loses its ability to infect cells until present in the tumor microenvironment, where the linker is cleaved by tumor-enriched matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs).
